usage: 電費 is used as a noun to refer to the cost of electricity used over a period.
You can say 'pay the 電費' to mean paying the electricity bill.
It often appears in sentences describing household expenses.
電費 can be combined with words indicating time, such as 'this month's 電費' or 'last month's 電費'.
It is common to ask about 電費 when discussing utility costs.
